name_zh: 102年低收入戶及中低收入戶生活狀況調查-戶中重大傷病者資料
name_en: The Low-income and Middle-income Family Living Condition Survey
data_description_zh:
1. 為明瞭低收入戶及中低收入戶生活狀況，特依據社會救助法第 13 條第 3 項：
「主管機關應至少每五年舉辦低收入戶及中低收入戶生活狀況調查，並出版統計
報告。」及統計法之規定，以及衛福部 102 年度施政計畫，辦理低收入戶及中
低收入戶生活狀況調查。
2. 主要蒐集低收入戶及中低收入戶之家庭組成（包括有工作能力人口及其就業意
願）、住宅及設備狀況、戶內人口健康狀況、經濟情況，對政府辦理社會救助（包
括生活扶助、醫療補助、急難救助及災害救助）、福利措施之利用與期望等資料。
3. 資料為102 年低收入及中低收入戶生活狀況調查-戶中重大傷病者。
notes_zh:
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等
欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審
核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。

fields.name_zh: 罹患的慢性或重大傷病種類
fields.description_zh:
01 循環系統疾病(如心臟病、高血壓、腦血管病變(中風)等)
02 骨骼肌肉系統疾病(如關節炎、骨質疏鬆症、紅斑性狼瘡等) 03 內分泌及代謝疾病(如糖尿病、甲狀腺機能障礙、高血脂症、痛風等)
04 消化系統疾病(如消化性潰瘍、肝硬化、慢性肝炎、慢性膽道炎等)
05 眼、耳等器官疾病(如青光眼、乾眼症、眼角膜病變、中耳炎、耳朵病變等)
06 呼吸系統疾病(如氣(哮)喘、慢性鼻炎、支氣管炎、肺氣腫、肺炎等)
07 泌尿系統疾病(如慢性腎臟炎、腎臟感染、尿毒症等)
08 血液及造血器官疾病(如血友病、貧血、紫斑症等)
09 癌症(惡性腫瘤)
10 精神疾病(如精神病、憂鬱症、躁鬱症等)
11 皮膚及皮下組織疾病(如烏腳病、乾癬、濕疹、白斑等)
12 神經系統疾病(如巴金森氏症、肌僵直萎縮症、癲癇、脊髓損傷等)
13 其他疾病(如傳染病之甲癬及結核病、痔瘡、攝護腺肥大、尿失禁、先天性畸形疾病等)
14 重大創傷（如因外力、車禍造成身體或肢體部份受重創而受嚴重傷害等）
15 多重傷病（二種以上慢性或重大傷病）
16 非屬以上慢性或重大傷病種類之身心障礙
fields.name_zh_en: Type of chronic illness or catastrophic illness
fields.description_en:
01 Circulatory system diseases (e.g. heart disease, hypertension, cerebrovascular disease (stroke))
02 Musculoskeletal system diseases (e.g. arthritis, osteoporosis, lupus erythematosus) 03 Endocrine and metabolic diseases (e.g. diabetes, thyroid dysfunction, hyperlipidemia, gout)
04 Digestive system diseases (e.g. peptic ulcer, cirrhosis, chronic hepatitis, chronic cholangitis)
05 Diseases of the eye, ear and other organs (e.g. glaucoma, dry eye, corneal disease, otitis media, ear disorders)
06 Respiratory system diseases (e.g. asthma, chronic rhinitis, bronchitis, emphysema, pneumonia)
07 Urinary system diseases (e.g. chronic nephritis, kidney infection, uremia)
08 Diseases of the blood and blood-forming organs (e.g. hemophilia, anemia, purpura)
09 Cancer (malignant tumor)
10 Mental disorders (e.g. psychosis, depression, bipolar disorder)
11 Diseases of the skin and subcutaneous tissue (e.g. blackfoot disease, psoriasis, eczema, vitiligo)
12 Nervous system diseases (e.g. Parkinson's disease, myotonic dystrophy, epilepsy, spinal cord injury)
13 Other diseases (e.g. tinea unguium and tuberculosis among infectious diseases, hemorrhoids, prostate enlargement, urinary incontinence, congenital malformations)
14 Major trauma (e.g. severe injury to the body or limbs caused by external force or a traffic accident)
15 Multiple illnesses or injuries (two or more chronic or catastrophic illnesses)
16 Disability not belonging to the above types of chronic or catastrophic illness

data_description_en:
1. To understand the living conditions of low-income and middle-low-income households, this living conditions survey is conducted under Article 13, Paragraph 3 of the Public Assistance Act:
"The competent authority shall conduct a survey of the living conditions of low-income and middle-low-income households at least every five years and publish a statistical
report.", the Statistics Act, and the ROC year 102 (2013) administrative plan of the Ministry of Health and Welfare.
income and middle-low-income households.
2. It mainly collects data on the household composition of low-income and middle-low-income households (including persons able to work and their willingness
to work), housing and equipment, health of household members, economic situation, and use of and expectations for government social assistance (including
living assistance, medical subsidies, emergency relief and disaster relief) and welfare measures.
3. The data are from the ROC year 102 (2013) Survey of living conditions of low-income and middle-low-income households - household members with catastrophic illness.
notes_en:
* The database of this Center has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been deleted; fields such as national ID number,
facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of medical visit and date of admission
have all been masked; and the data may only be used within the independent work area set up by this Ministry, with only statistical results that have passed review
being taken out, to ensure that data use and disclosure make it impossible to identify specific individuals.
